title: ScopeConfig
description: Tenant scope-node configuration for federation tenancy. Spec v1.3 §4.6 + §11.4. Consumed by internal/contextus/tenancy.LoadScopeConfig; Wyrd-side counterpart is wyrd/store.LoadScopeConfig (Wyrd PR #40).

physical_scopes.description: Physical (spatiotemporal) scope-node declarations. Each entry maps to pkg/types.ScopePhysical.

conceptual_scopes.description: Conceptual (topic/domain) scope-node declarations. Each entry maps to pkg/types.ScopeConceptual.

operational_scopes.description: Operational (hardware-instance-bounded) scope-node declarations per Contextus-Spec-Addendum-NT-Scope-Operational §6. Each entry maps to pkg/types.ScopeOperational. Third sibling to physical_scopes + conceptual_scopes; membership predicate is hardware-identifier-based (exact match on host_id + hardware_class; no wildcards at v0.1).

scope_memberships.description: Membership edges connecting scope nodes to member nodes. Each entry maps to pkg/types.ScopeMembership. weight_tier is a Wyrd-envelope field (model.Weight.Tier); it is NOT part of pkg/types.ScopeMembership.

tenant_profile.description: Optional tenant identity + subscriber profile per Contextus-Spec-Addendum-Research-Aid-Tenancy §3.2. Maps to pkg/types.TenantProfile. BMA Spec 9.4 consumer.

PhysicalScopeEntry.description: A physical scope declaration. id + description + type_nodes are the Contextus payload. tier_immune + salience are Wyrd-envelope fields that thread to model.Node.TierImmune / model.Node.Salience.

id.description: Non-empty, globally unique scope identifier. Convention: contextus:scope:physical:<slug>.

description.description: Human-readable description of this physical scope.

type_nodes.description: Type-node strings that classify this scope. Forward references are allowed at v0.1.

bounds.description: Spatiotemporal bounds for this physical scope.

parent_scope_id.description: Optional parent scope identifier for hierarchical nesting.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for this scope.

tier_immune.description: Wyrd-envelope field: when true, the resulting model.Node is exempt from tier-based decay. NOT part of pkg/types.ScopePhysical. Defaults to false.

salience.description: Wyrd-envelope field: salience score [0.0, 1.0] threaded to model.Node.Salience. NOT part of pkg/types.ScopePhysical. Defaults to 0.0.

ConceptualScopeEntry.description: A conceptual scope declaration. id + description + type_nodes are the Contextus payload. tier_immune + salience are Wyrd-envelope fields.

id.description: Non-empty, globally unique scope identifier. Convention: contextus:scope:conceptual:<slug>.

description.description: Human-readable description of this conceptual scope.

type_nodes.description: Type-node strings that classify this scope.

ontology_uri.description: Optional URI pointing to an ontology term that this scope represents.

parent_scope_id.description: Optional parent scope identifier for hierarchical nesting.

tier_immune.description: Wyrd-envelope field: when true, the resulting model.Node is exempt from tier-based decay. NOT part of pkg/types.ScopeConceptual. Defaults to false.

salience.description: Wyrd-envelope field: salience score [0.0, 1.0] threaded to model.Node.Salience. NOT part of pkg/types.ScopeConceptual. Defaults to 0.0.

OperationalScopeEntry.description: An operational scope declaration per Contextus-Spec-Addendum-NT-Scope-Operational §3 + §6. id + description + type_nodes + host_id + hardware_class are the Contextus payload. tier_immune + salience are Wyrd-envelope fields (precedent: Wyrd PR #40 §2.1).

id.description: Non-empty, globally unique scope identifier. Convention: contextus:scope:operational:<slug>.

description.description: Human-readable description of this operational scope.

type_nodes.description: Type-node strings that classify this scope. Conventional value: NT_SCOPE_OPERATIONAL.

host_id.description: Federation-unique host identifier per spec §3. Conventionally derived from /etc/machine-id, hardware UUID, or a beekeeper-asserted identifier. Examples: bma-prime, sharp-butler-house-node-01, qbp-cu-silicon-rev-A.

hardware_class.description: One of the v0.1 hardware-class tags per spec §4. Empty string permitted for host-level umbrella scopes (a host-level operational scope with hardware_class="" nests per-subsystem children via parent_scope_id).

parent_scope_id.description: Optional parent scope identifier for hierarchical nesting (host umbrella → per-subsystem child pattern per spec §5).

tags.description: Optional free-form tags. Conventional inclusion: a runtime.<instance-class> tag identifying the federation tenant the host serves (e.g. runtime.bma-instance).

tier_immune.description: Wyrd-envelope field: when true, the resulting model.Node is exempt from tier-based decay. NOT part of pkg/types.ScopeOperational. Defaults to false. Operational scopes are typically tier_immune: true per spec §6.2.

salience.description: Wyrd-envelope field: salience score [0.0, 1.0] threaded to model.Node.Salience. NOT part of pkg/types.ScopeOperational. Defaults to 0.0.

ScopeMembershipEntry.description: A membership edge. scope + member + confidence + provenance_tag + method are the Contextus payload. weight_tier is a Wyrd-envelope field that threads to model.Weight.Tier.

scope.description: Scope identifier (must match an id in physical_scopes or conceptual_scopes).

member.description: Member node identifier that belongs to the scope.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp from which membership holds. Defaults to zero time if omitted.

provenance_tag.description: Provenance tag: P=asserted, D=inferred, T=theoretical, I=imported. Mirrors ProvenanceTag* constants.

method.description: Adapter-defined membership predicate string. See Spec §4.6.5.

weight_tier.description: Wyrd-envelope field: maps to model.Weight.Tier for the constructed membership hyperedge. NOT part of pkg/types.ScopeMembership. Defaults to 'complex' per Wyrd PR #40 §2.1.

PhysicalBounds.description: Spatiotemporal bounds for a physical scope. lat/lon are [min, max] pairs in decimal degrees; time is [start, end] ISO 8601; height is [min_m, max_m] elevation in metres.

lat.description: Latitude range [south, north] in decimal degrees.

lon.description: Longitude range [west, east] in decimal degrees.

time.description: Temporal range [start, end] as ISO 8601 timestamps.

height.description: Elevation range [min_m, max_m] in metres. Negative values are below sea level.
